sql: SELECT count(*) FROM opportunity_candidates
SELECT count(*) FROM opportunity_signals
SELECT count(*) FROM opportunity_alerts
SELECT count(*) FROM opportunity_observations
SELECT count(*) FROM opportunity_candidates WHERE eligible=1
SELECT count(*) FROM opportunity_candidates c WHERE eligible=1 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM opportunity_signals s WHERE s.candidate_id=c.id AND s.kind='baseline')
SELECT count(*) FROM opportunity_alerts WHERE severity='critical'
SELECT count(*) FROM opportunity_alerts WHERE delivered_in_app_at IS NOT NULL
SELECT count(*) FROM opportunity_alerts WHERE telegram_state='acknowledged_by_api'

SELECT c.id,json_extract(c.discovery,'$.price_usd') AS initial_price, json_extract(CASE WHEN typeof(o.payload)='blob' THEN archive_text(o.payload) ELSE o.payload END,'$.market.price_usd','$.market.observed_at', '$.security.observed_at','$.decision.verdict','$.decision.security_filter_passed', '$.decision.liquidity_filter_passed') AS fields FROM opportunity_candidates c LEFT JOIN opportunity_observations o ON o.id=( SELECT id FROM opportunity_observations WHERE candidate_id=c.id ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1)

SELECT o.signal_id,o.horizon_seconds,o.state,json_extract(o.payload,'$.pnl_usd') AS pnl, s.kind,s.at AS signal_at,s.observation_id,a.id AS alert_id,c.contract, e.control_member,e.provenance AS enrollment_provenance,e.at AS enrolled_at, json_extract(s.payload,'$.policy.id','$.policy.at','$.policy.payload.config.test_from', '$.policy.payload.config.entry_window_seconds', '$.policy.payload.config.exit_window_seconds') AS policy_fields FROM opportunity_outcomes o JOIN opportunity_signals s ON s.id=o.signal_id JOIN opportunity_candidates c ON c.id=s.candidate_id LEFT JOIN opportunity_alerts a ON a.signal_id=s.id AND a.severity!='critical' LEFT JOIN sampling_enrollment e ON e.candidate_id=c.id ORDER BY s.id,o.horizon_seconds
SELECT json_extract(payload,'$.features.excessive_extension') AS extended FROM opportunity_alerts

SELECT s.id, json_extract(CASE WHEN typeof(o.payload)='blob' THEN archive_text(o.payload) ELSE o.payload END,'$.features.changes.5m.volume_5m_ratio', '$.features.excessive_extension','$.narrative.supported', '$.decision.security_filter_passed','$.decision.liquidity_filter_passed', '$.decision.verdict') AS fields FROM opportunity_signals s JOIN opportunity_observations o ON o.id=s.observation_id WHERE s.kind='baseline'
SELECT * FROM sampling_metadata WHERE id=1

SELECT e.provenance,e.control_member,count(*) AS n,sum(c.last_attempt_at IS NULL) AS never_observed FROM sampling_enrollment e JOIN opportunity_candidates c ON c.id=e.candidate_id WHERE c.eligible=1 GROUP BY e.provenance,e.control_member

SELECT phase,reported_status AS status,reported_reason AS reason,selected,control_member,provenance,count(*) AS n FROM (SELECT j.*,e.provenance,CASE WHEN status='pending' AND deadline_at<? THEN 'missed' ELSE status END AS reported_status,CASE WHEN status='pending' AND deadline_at<? THEN CASE WHEN last_dispatch_at IS NULL THEN 'capacity_or_worker_gap' ELSE 'collection_finished_after_deadline' END ELSE reason END AS reported_reason FROM observation_jobs j LEFT JOIN sampling_enrollment e ON e.candidate_id=j.candidate_id) GROUP BY phase,reported_status,reported_reason,selected,control_member,provenance

WITH quotes AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT id,candidate_id,at,json_extract(CASE WHEN typeof(payload)='blob' THEN archive_text(payload) ELSE payload END,'$.market.price_usd', '$.market.liquidity_usd','$.market.observed_at','$.source_kind', '$.market.address','$.market.pair_address') AS fields FROM opportunity_observations WHERE id IN ( SELECT observation_id FROM observation_jobs WHERE status='attempted' AND (selected=1 OR control_member=1) ) ) SELECT j.phase,j.selected,j.control_member,e.provenance, capture_price_state(o.fields,o.at, j.due_at,j.deadline_at,json_extract(p.payload,'$.observation_rules.max_snapshot_age'), c.contract,c.pool) AS price_state,count(*) AS n FROM observation_jobs j JOIN opportunity_candidates c ON c.id=j.candidate_id LEFT JOIN sampling_enrollment e ON e.candidate_id=c.id LEFT JOIN quotes o ON o.id=j.observation_id AND o.candidate_id=c.id LEFT JOIN opportunity_signals s ON s.id=j.signal_id LEFT JOIN opportunity_policies p ON p.id=s.policy_id WHERE j.status='attempted' AND (j.selected=1 OR j.control_member=1) GROUP BY j.phase,j.selected,j.control_member,e.provenance,price_state
SELECT count(*) AS jobs,count(DISTINCT candidate_id) AS candidates,min(deadline_at) AS earliest FROM observation_jobs WHERE status='pending' AND due_at<=? AND deadline_at>=?

SELECT j.id,j.candidate_id,c.contract,c.chain,e.provenance,j.signal_id,j.phase,j.horizon_seconds,j.due_at,j.deadline_at,j.reason,o.at AS observed_at,json_extract(CASE WHEN typeof(o.payload)='blob' THEN archive_text(o.payload) ELSE o.payload END,'$.market.observed_at') AS quote_observed_at,json_extract(CASE WHEN typeof(o.payload)='blob' THEN archive_text(o.payload) ELSE o.payload END,'$.source_kind') AS source_kind FROM observation_jobs j JOIN opportunity_candidates c ON c.id=j.candidate_id JOIN sampling_enrollment e ON e.candidate_id=c.id JOIN opportunity_observations o ON o.id=j.observation_id WHERE j.status='attempted' AND j.selected=1 AND e.provenance='prospective' ORDER BY o.id DESC,j.id DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT j.id,j.candidate_id,c.contract,c.chain,e.provenance,j.signal_id,j.phase,j.horizon_seconds,j.due_at,j.deadline_at,j.reason,o.at AS observed_at,json_extract(CASE WHEN typeof(o.payload)='blob' THEN archive_text(o.payload) ELSE o.payload END,'$.market.observed_at') AS quote_observed_at,json_extract(CASE WHEN typeof(o.payload)='blob' THEN archive_text(o.payload) ELSE o.payload END,'$.source_kind') AS source_kind FROM observation_jobs j JOIN opportunity_candidates c ON c.id=j.candidate_id JOIN sampling_enrollment e ON e.candidate_id=c.id JOIN opportunity_observations o ON o.id=j.observation_id WHERE j.status='attempted' AND j.selected=1 AND e.provenance='prospective' AND j.phase=? ORDER BY o.id DESC,j.id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT j.id,j.candidate_id,c.contract,c.chain,e.provenance,j.signal_id,j.phase,j.horizon_seconds,j.due_at,j.deadline_at,j.reason,o.at AS observed_at,json_extract(CASE WHEN typeof(o.payload)='blob' THEN archive_text(o.payload) ELSE o.payload END,'$.market.observed_at') AS quote_observed_at,json_extract(CASE WHEN typeof(o.payload)='blob' THEN archive_text(o.payload) ELSE o.payload END,'$.source_kind') AS source_kind FROM observation_jobs j JOIN opportunity_candidates c ON c.id=j.candidate_id JOIN sampling_enrollment e ON e.candidate_id=c.id JOIN opportunity_observations o ON o.id=j.observation_id WHERE j.status='attempted' AND j.control_member=1 AND e.provenance='prospective' ORDER BY o.id DESC,j.id DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT j.id,j.candidate_id,c.contract,c.chain,e.provenance,j.signal_id,j.phase,j.horizon_seconds,j.due_at,j.deadline_at,j.reason,o.at AS observed_at,json_extract(CASE WHEN typeof(o.payload)='blob' THEN archive_text(o.payload) ELSE o.payload END,'$.market.observed_at') AS quote_observed_at,json_extract(CASE WHEN typeof(o.payload)='blob' THEN archive_text(o.payload) ELSE o.payload END,'$.source_kind') AS source_kind FROM observation_jobs j JOIN opportunity_candidates c ON c.id=j.candidate_id JOIN sampling_enrollment e ON e.candidate_id=c.id JOIN opportunity_observations o ON o.id=j.observation_id WHERE j.status='attempted' AND j.control_member=1 AND e.provenance='prospective' AND j.phase=? ORDER BY o.id DESC,j.id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT address FROM positions WHERE closed_at IS NULL

WITH promises(candidate_id) AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT candidate_id FROM observation_jobs WHERE status='pending' AND deadline_at>=:clock UNION SELECT s.candidate_id FROM opportunity_outcomes o JOIN opportunity_signals s ON s.id=o.signal_id WHERE o.state='pending' UNION SELECT e.candidate_id FROM routed_outcomes o JOIN routed_experiments e ON e.signal_id=o.signal_id WHERE o.state IN ('pending','collecting') UNION SELECT candidate_id FROM routed_experiments WHERE entry_state IN ('entry_pending','collecting') ), due_promises(candidate_id) AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT DISTINCT candidate_id FROM observation_jobs WHERE status='pending' AND due_at<=:clock AND deadline_at>=:clock ), manual_contracts(address) AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT address FROM tokens WHERE watch=1 UNION SELECT address FROM positions WHERE closed_at IS NULL UNION SELECT value FROM json_each(:news_holdings) ), story_candidates(candidate_id) AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT c.id FROM story_pool_lookups l JOIN opportunity_candidates c ON c.chain='solana' AND c.contract=l.contract WHERE l.state='existing_candidate' AND julianday(json_extract(l.payload,'$.last_checked_at')) BETWEEN julianday(:active_from) AND julianday(:at) AND (json_extract(l.payload,'$.current_evidence.association')='exact_contract_document_mention' OR (json_extract(l.payload,'$.current_evidence.association')='resolved_market_pair_reference' AND json_extract(l.payload,'$.current_evidence.market_reference.qualifies_for_discovery')=1)) ), monitoring AS ( SELECT c.id,c.next_due,c.last_attempt_at,c.ingested_at, c.id IN (SELECT candidate_id FROM promises) AS has_promises, c.id IN (SELECT candidate_id FROM due_promises) AS has_due_promises, CASE WHEN c.eligible=0 THEN 'excluded' WHEN c.last_attempt_at IS NULL THEN 'awaiting_first_observation' WHEN c.contract IN (SELECT address FROM manual_contracts) THEN 'manual_watch' WHEN c.id IN (SELECT candidate_id FROM story_candidates) THEN 'reactivated' WHEN julianday(c.ingested_at)>=julianday(:active_from) THEN 'active' WHEN c.id IN (SELECT candidate_id FROM promises) THEN 'followup' WHEN julianday(c.ingested_at) IS NULL THEN 'metadata_unknown' WHEN julianday(c.ingested_at)>=julianday(:background_from) THEN 'background' ELSE 'paused' END AS state FROM opportunity_candidates c ) SELECT state,count(*) AS candidates, sum(next_due<=:clock) AS due, sum(last_attempt_at IS NULL) AS not_enriched, sum(has_due_promises) AS promised_due, sum(has_due_promises AND next_due>:clock) AS promised_outside_periodic, min(CASE WHEN next_due<=:clock THEN next_due END) AS oldest FROM monitoring GROUP BY state
